item.title: Harry Kane's England Journey Examined
item.description: BBC Sport reviews Harry Kane's historic international journey with the England squad. The retrospective covers his impressive debut goal through to setting a new national appearance record.

item.description: Test your knowledge of English football history by naming every male player who has earned 60 or more international caps.

item.title: Bomb Threats Trigger Italy School Evacuations
item.description: Educational institutions throughout Italy faced consecutive days of bomb threats, leading to widespread disruption and building clearances.

item.description: ঢাকা বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ে ককটেল বিস্ফোরণের ঘটনায় এক শিক্ষার্থীকে সাময়িক বহিষ্কার করা হয়েছে। প্রক্টরিয়াল ক্ষমতার বলে এই ব্যবস্থা নেওয়া হয় এবং ঘটনার তদন্তে একটি কমিটি গঠন করা হয়েছে।

item.title: Private passenger ship service between Beypore and Lakshadweep soon
item.description: As reported by The Hindu, As part of the trial, the ship, capable of accommodating 250 passengers, anchored safely at the port wharf. Key points: Private, Beypore, Lakshadweep, Maiden.

item.title: Google Updates Search Engine with Gemini 4 Hydrogen AI
item.description: Google has enhanced its search engine using the Gemini 4 Hydrogen model. The AI mode now better processes intricate questions, provides pertinent links, and displays enhanced visual content.

item.title: Family Member Found Guilty of Child Rape
item.description: A relative has been formally convicted for the sexual assault of a minor. Legal authorities delivered the verdict following the trial.

item.title: Obscure Elder Scrolls Game Shadowkey Receives 4K Port
item.description: The former N-Gage exclusive title Shadowkey has been upgraded for PCs using AI coding. The remastered version includes a 4K visual overhaul and numerous added features.

item.title: Lionel Scaloni to Manage Argentina Until 2030 World Cup
item.description: Lionel Scaloni has extended his contract to remain the head coach of Argentina for another four years. The Argentine Football Association announced the agreement on Thursday.

item.title: Authorities Advise Suspending Bus Driver Licence After Crash
item.description: Following a vehicular incident in Kakkanad, local police have formally suggested the revocation of the bus operator's driving permit.

item.title: Four Recommended Religious Practices for Muslims on Friday
item.description: Islamic tradition highlights four specific acts for believers on Fridays that many overlook. The Prophet Muhammad particularly encouraged these religious observances.

item.title: Ernakulam Medical College Hosts Eye Donation Awareness Event
item.description: An outreach program focused on eye donation took place at the Ernakulam facility. The gathering preceded the institution's submission for a corneal transplant permit.

item.title: Awami League Plots Will Be Resisted on Streets: Joglul
item.description: During a protest rally, central leaders reaffirmed their commitment to Prime Minister Tarique Rahman’s Bangladesh First policy. Retired Colonel Joglul Ahsan stated that political opposition would be actively countered.

item.title: Sonam Wangchuk calls Leh house arrest and restrictions vague
item.description: Activist Sonam Wangchuk stated that the Ladakh administration's actions against him are baseless and arbitrary. Authorities recently moved him from a demonstration site to his Leh home and reportedly blocked him from going outside.

item.title: AIADMK leader Palaniswami dismisses Sasikala and Dhinakaran return
item.description: AIADMK general secretary K. Palaniswami has dismissed rumors regarding the potential reintegration of T.T.V. Dhinakaran and V.K. Sasikala into the political party. He made it clear that these speculations are unfounded.

item.title: Texas court overturns 500-foot trust property restraining order
item.description: A Texas appeals court lifted a restriction preventing a granddaughter from nearing family trust assets. The panel ruled that the previous court omitted trial scheduling and security bond requirements.

item.title: Minister Rajmohan states low attendance won't shutter state schools
item.description: Minister Rajmohan announced that state-run schools will not shut down due to a lack of students. Authorities confirmed that low enrollment figures will not trigger school closures.

item.title: Ranipet police arrest suspects with 500 kg of red sanders
item.description: Law enforcement in Ranipet apprehended a group near Sholinghur for possessing 500 kg of red sandalwood logs. The illicit timber was seized during the operation.

item.title: খুলনায় দোকানে ঢুকে বিএনপি নেতা জাকির হোসেনকে গুলি করে হত্যা
item.description: খুলনার রূপসায় একটি দোকানে ঢুকে জাকির হোসেন নামের এক বিএনপি নেতাকে গুলি করেছে দুর্বৃত্তরা। পরে স্থানীয়রা তাঁকে উদ্ধার করে উপজেলা স্বাস্থ্য কমপ্লেক্সে নিলে চিকিৎসকেরা মৃত ঘোষণা করেন।

item.title: Dhinakaran calls for safety inspections on Children's Day cakes
item.description: Politician Dhinakaran has demanded official quality inspections for cakes distributed on Children's Day. He emphasized the need to ensure food safety for minors.

item.title: Swiss heart surgeon sets record with 3200 cardiac items
item.description: Swiss cardiac surgeon Diana Reser updated her world record with a collection of 3,200 heart-shaped items. She started gathering these pieces during her university years following presents from family and friends.

item.title: Nectar introduces artificial intelligence tool for influencer campaigns
item.description: A fresh AI agent released by Nectar assists companies in finding internet creators, handling communications, and monitoring promotion metrics.

item.title: Würzburg doctoral researchers accidentally synthesize rare molecules
item.description: While analyzing reactions involving diboracumulene and ketones, two University of Würzburg students generated stable oxoboranes with boron-oxygen triple bonds.

item.title: CMC plans poster contest and exhibition for World Diabetes Day
item.description: To observe World Diabetes Day, CMC is hosting a public exhibition alongside a poster design competition.

item.title: Texas transforms dismantled bridge into massive marine reef
item.description: Authorities in Texas repurposed a 6,620-foot torn-down bridge to establish a 320-acre artificial marine habitat.

item.title: Illegal structures removed on Vaniyambadi roadway for student access
item.description: Unauthorised constructions along Ismalaiya College Road in Vaniyambadi were cleared away to improve student passage.

item.title: Microsoft email service experiences unexpected technical disruption
item.description: An interruption is impacting users of Microsoft's Outlook platform. The company has not yet identified the root cause.

item.title: Blaze destroys five electric scooters in Ranipet district
item.description: A sudden fire incident resulted in the destruction of five electronic scooters located in Ranipet.

item.title: Hegseth honors guard who previously scolded him and colleagues
item.description: Specialist Thomas Iglesias received the Joint Service Commendation Medal for performing his duties following an altercation on Wednesday.

item.title: Lewisham Islamic Centre Criticizes Charity Watchdog's Warning
item.description: The London mosque has condemned a regulatory reprimand regarding its remarks on Palestine. Administrators argued that the oversight body applies unfair standards specifically to Islamic philanthropic groups.

item.title: Engineering Student Detained for Setting Woman on Fire
item.description: Police have taken an engineering student into custody following an incident where a woman was targeted with flames. The attack reportedly stemmed from a declined romantic advance.

item.title: Vellore Region Releases Draft Voter List
item.description: Authorities in Vellore and surrounding areas have made their preliminary electoral registry public. Citizens can now review the newly published voter rolls for the district.

item.title: Google Launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen Model
item.description: Google has introduced the Gemini 4 Hydrogen software to supplant version 3.8 Flash. Unlike prior releases, this update bypassed a gradual, security-focused deployment phase.

item.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Steps Down
item.description: Jensen Huang has departed from his role leading Nvidia, a tech firm he established in 1993 alongside partners. His departure leaves the organization without an immediate successor announced.

item.title: Four Detained for Homicide in Raja Annamalaipuram
item.description: Law enforcement has apprehended four individuals in connection with the fatal stabbing of a 27-year-old male. The violent crime occurred in the Raja Annamalaipuram neighborhood.

item.title: Global Outage Affects Microsoft Outlook Service
item.description: Users worldwide have experienced disruptions accessing their Outlook email via applications and web browsers. Microsoft acknowledged the service failure through its status communications channel.

item.title: Two Apprehended for 27 Lakh Dating App Fraud
item.description: Authorities have captured two suspects accused of defrauding a victim of 27 lakh rupees. The financial scam was executed through a digital dating platform.

item.title: Origins of Nvidia at a Silicon Valley Diner
item.description: In 1992 and 1993, founders Jensen Huang, Chris Malachowsky, and Curtis Priem held foundational discussions for Nvidia at a local Denny's restaurant.

item.title: Background of Nvidia Interim CEO Collette Kress
item.description: Before stepping into her current role at Nvidia in 2013, Collette Kress accumulated 25 years of experience across multiple financial positions.

item.title: Nvidia Shares Drop 13 Percent Following CEO Departure
item.description: Following Jensen Huang's resignation, Nvidia stock plummeted 13 percent. CFO and Executive VP Colette Kress has been appointed interim chief executive.

item.title: Fire Disrupts Shillong Literary Festival Event
item.description: A blaze destroyed four food stalls at the Shillong Lit Fest location. Organizers had to suspend an ongoing musical performance because of the incident.

item.title: Waterlogging Challenges Chennai Green Cover Goals
item.description: The Greater Chennai Corporation aims to raise the municipality's greenery from 18 to 33 percent, though standing water poses a major obstacle to planting efforts.

item.title: শাপলা চত্বরে গণহত্যার অভিযোগ প্রধান প্রসিকিউটরের
item.description: ২০১৩ সালের শাপলা চত্বর উচ্ছেদ অভিযানকে একটি ভয়াবহ হত্যাকাণ্ড বলে অভিহিত করেছেন প্রধান প্রসিকিউটর। তার মতে, এ ঘটনার আসামিরা মানবতাবিরোধী অপরাধে জড়িত।

item.title: Microsoft 365 Platforms Hit by Service Disruption
item.description: High traffic volumes have triggered technical failures affecting several Microsoft 365 applications, including Teams and Outlook.

item.title: Ukraine Links Starshield Restrictions to Russian Raids
item.description: Ukraine reports that renewed speed restrictions on Starshield hinder its defense against Russian attacks. Officials believe these limitations aim to assist Russia during peace negotiations.

item.title: Sonam Wangchuk Alleges Confinement Prior to Ladakh Demonstration
item.description: Activist Sonam Wangchuk reported being placed under detention ahead of a planned agitation. He previously rejected winter polls, stating many residents leave the area during that season.

item.title: Pro-Palestine Philanthropist Awaits Extradition Hearing in Spain
item.description: James 'Fergie' Chambers contests allegations against him in a Spanish court. Meanwhile, his spouse has requested Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez to provide him with political asylum.

item.title: নুসরাতের মামলা: অগ্নিসংযোগ ও বিস্ফোরণে পরিবারকে হত্যার চেষ্টা
item.description: পরিবারকে পুড়িয়ে ও বিস্ফোরণ ঘটিয়ে হত্যার চেষ্টার অভিযোগে মামলা করেছেন নুসরাত। তবে তদন্তের গোপনীয়তা রক্ষা করতে পুলিশ অভিযুক্তদের নাম প্রকাশ করতে রাজি হয়নি।

item.title: Chinese Researchers Chill Atoms Close to Absolute Zero in Space
item.description: Aboard the Tiangong orbiting laboratory, Chinese researchers utilized laser confinement to lower an atomic cluster nearly to absolute zero. This achievement establishes a new benchmark for chilling atoms.

item.title: Madurai Development Works Reviewed by Appointed Officer
item.description: An official monitoring officer conducted an inspection of ongoing infrastructure and development initiatives in Madurai. The visit focused on evaluating the progress of these local projects.

item.title: American envoys visit Moscow for discussions with Putin
item.description: US representatives have landed in Moscow to hold discussions regarding Ukraine with Russian President Vladimir Putin. On Thursday, Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff are scheduled to head to Dublin for a meeting with Ukrainian leader Volodymyr Zelensky.

item.title: Madras High Court Verdict on Book Scam Mentions PM's Radio Show
item.description: Justice G R Swaminathan included commendation for the prime minister's radio broadcast within a court order. The ruling was issued on November 11 by a division bench at the Madurai jurisdiction.

item.title: Nvidia Leadership Shift Sparks Uncertainty Over Open-Source Support
item.description: The departure of CEO Jensen Huang creates doubts regarding Nvidia's future dedication to open-source artificial intelligence. This transition affects open-weight models, acquisitions, and opposition to regulatory limits.

item.title: শাহরুখ খানের গৃহস্থালির সব সিদ্ধান্ত নেন গৌরী খান
item.description: সিনেমা জগতে শাহরুখ খানের ব্যাপক আধিপত্য থাকলেও ঘরের ভেতরে তাঁর প্রভাব কম। অভিনেতার নিজের বক্তব্য অনুযায়ী, ওয়াই-ফাই সংযোগ থেকে শুরু করে ঘরের দেয়ালের রঙ—সব সিদ্ধান্তই নেন তাঁর স্ত্রী গৌরী।

item.title: TNPDCL Plans to Acquire 3,000 Megawatts
item.description: The distribution corporation in Tamil Nadu has formally requested official approval to purchase 3,000 megawatts of power. The utility submitted the proposal to secure adequate electricity supply for the region.

item.title: Cuddalore, Villupuram, and Kallakurichi Publish Voter Lists
item.description: Officials have published the consolidated draft voter lists for the districts of Cuddalore, Villupuram, and Kallakurichi. This release marks an update to the regional electoral rolls.

item.title: Kerala Congress Ally Leader Arrested for Extortion
item.description: Police have detained the leader of a political party allied with Congress in Kerala in connection with an extortion investigation. What began as a local extortion complaint has expanded into a probe regarding an alleged countrywide scam.
